query:
-- Usuários que fizeram login recentemente (últimos 30 dias)
SELECT id, openId, name, email, role, lastSignedIn
FROM users
WHERE lastSignedIn >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
ORDER BY lastSignedIn DESC
LIMIT 20;
